_note: The fixed Band 2 input corpus. Two documents, twelve reference/citance
pairs, chosen so that every route the band can produce is exercised at
least once -- the point of a route-distribution test is the DENOMINATOR,
and a denominator that never sees an exclusion bucket does not pin it.
Each pair names the route it was authored to reach. That name is
documentation of INTENT and is never asserted against: the test asserts
the distribution the real pipeline produces, recorded into a golden file.
If the code disagrees with an intent note, the golden file is right and
